svg.text: Big Bend sector order vs park plan (as reported)
Sources: Reuters 3 Oct 2026; NYT 2 Oct 2026. Not a CBP mileage table.
Order: no barrier or ground-disturbing work in Big Bend Sector unless laws met
Park plan described as roads, sensors, vehicle barriers — not 30-ft wall
Voluntary pause: about 7 weeks before Friday order
Lawsuit stretch described by NYT as 500+ miles of frontier
